thread:
ivan: Found a reproducible issue during private CP e2e: split-horizon DNS + shared egress + IPv6 causes occasional gRPC stalls and cert SAN mismatches.

maya: can you show the resolver responses?

ivan: short excerpt:
```
VPC stub: cp.cust-999.rw -> 10.4.8.9, fd00:4:8::9
Central recursor: cp.cust-999.rw -> 34.210.22.5, 2604:abcd::5
```

li: happy-eyeballs picks the public AAAA intermittently, we hit the public path, hairpin SNAT happens, asymmetric routing and sometimes TLS name mismatch.

maya: options: force privatelink (best), opt-in no-SNAT egress routes, client pin private RDATA, or multi-SAN certs while transitioning.

ivan: short-term plan: 1) add a detection metric controlplane.dns.rdata_mismatch and alert on >0.1% for a customer; 2) issue multi-SAN certs for affected customers; 3) agent tweak to prefer VPC-stub addresses when present (opt-in).

li: mid-term: console opt-in wizard to create egress no-snat rules or suggest interface endpoints. Ask for explicit consent before modifying customer infra.

infra-bot: task NET-514 created: "detect-dns-rdata-mismatch-and-agent-pin" assigned to @maya

maya: I'll run a 14-day spike to see how many customers are impacted and prototype the agent pin.

ivan: thanks. I'll draft the RFC follow-up with the phased mitigation and link NET-514. Close after spike results.
